package CUBE_PACKAGE

import (
	"context"
	"database/sql"
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"reflect"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	_ "github.com/mattn/go-sqlite3"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
	"github.com/viant/bindly/resource"
	"github.com/viant/datly/bootstrap"
	httpgateway "github.com/viant/datly/gateway/http"
	"github.com/viant/datly/mcp"
	"github.com/viant/datly/report"
	druntime "github.com/viant/datly/runtime"
	"github.com/viant/datly/spec"
	dsql "github.com/viant/datly/sql"
	"github.com/viant/datly/tag"
	"github.com/viant/datly/typecatalog"
	"github.com/viant/mcp-protocol/schema"
	_ "github.com/viant/sqlx/metadata/product/sqlite"
)

func componentFor(t *testing.T, holder, input, output reflect.Type) *spec.Component {
	t.Helper()
	field := holder.Field(0)
	metadata, _, err := tag.ParseComponent(field.Tag)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	source := &bootstrap.RouteSource{PackagePath: holder.PkgPath(), HolderType: holder.Name(), FieldName: field.Name, Tag: metadata, InputType: input.Name(), OutputType: output.Name()}
	component, err := source.Resolve(input, output)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	return component
}

func TestTranscribedCubeWireAndExecution(t *testing.T) {
	ctx := context.Background()
	names := []string{"VStart", "V100", "ViewConversions", "AccountID", "IsPG", "URL", "V25Threshold", "V100Window", "ControlVExposed"}
	wires := []string{"vStart", "v100", "viewConversions", "accountId", "isPg", "url", "v25Threshold", "v100Window", "controlVExposed"}
	sqlNames := []string{"v_start", "v100", "view_conversions", "account_id", "is_pg", "url", "v25_threshold", "v100_window", "control_v_exposed"}
	values := []int64{2, 100, 3, 7, 1, 9, 11, 12, 13}
	const body = `{"dimensions":{"v100":true,"accountId":true,"isPg":true,"url":true,"v25Threshold":true,"controlVExposed":true},"measures":{"vStart":true,"viewConversions":true,"v100Window":true},"filters":{"vStart":2,"v100":100,"viewConversions":3,"accountId":7,"isPg":1,"url":9,"v25Threshold":11,"v100Window":12,"controlVExposed":13,"accountIds":[7,8]}}`
	var bound MetricsCubeInput
	require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal([]byte(body), &bound))
	require.NotNil(t, bound.Filters.AccountIDs)
	require.Equal(t, []int{7, 8}, *bound.Filters.AccountIDs)
	for i, name := range names {
		section := "Dimensions"
		if i == 0 || i == 2 || i == 7 {
			section = "Measures"
		}
		owner, _ := reflect.TypeFor[MetricsCubeInput]().FieldByName(section)
		field, ok := owner.Type.FieldByName(name)
		require.True(t, ok, name)
		require.Equal(t, wires[i]+",omitempty", field.Tag.Get("json"))
		require.True(t, reflect.ValueOf(bound).FieldByName(section).FieldByName(name).Bool())
		filter := reflect.ValueOf(bound).FieldByName("Filters").FieldByName(name)
		require.False(t, filter.IsNil(), name)
		require.Equal(t, values[i], filter.Elem().Int())
		var row reflect.StructField
		for index := 0; index < reflect.TypeFor[MetricsRow]().NumField(); index++ {
			candidate := reflect.TypeFor[MetricsRow]().Field(index)
			if strings.Split(candidate.Tag.Get("sqlx"), ",")[0] == name {
				row = candidate
				break
			}
		}
		require.NotEmpty(t, row.Name, name)
		require.Equal(t, "reader_"+sqlNames[i], row.Tag.Get("json"))
		require.Contains(t, row.Tag.Get("sqlx"), name)
	}
	for _, section := range []string{"Dimensions", "Measures"} {
		field, _ := reflect.TypeFor[MetricsCubeInput]().FieldByName(section)
		_, found := field.Type.FieldByName("Hidden")
		require.False(t, found)
	}
	reader := componentFor(t, reflect.TypeFor[Component](), reflect.TypeFor[MetricsInput](), reflect.TypeFor[MetricsOutput]())
	cube := componentFor(t, reflect.TypeFor[MetricsCubeComponent](), reflect.TypeFor[MetricsCubeInput](), reflect.TypeFor[MetricsCubeOutput]())
	db, err := sql.Open("sqlite3", ":memory:")
	require.NoError(t, err)
	db.SetMaxOpenConns(1)
	defer db.Close()
	_, err = db.ExecContext(ctx, "CREATE TABLE events(v_start INTEGER,v100 INTEGER,view_conversions INTEGER,account_id INTEGER,is_pg INTEGER,url INTEGER,v25_threshold INTEGER,v100_window INTEGER,control_v_exposed INTEGER,hidden INTEGER)")
	require.NoError(t, err)
	_, err = db.ExecContext(ctx, "INSERT INTO events VALUES(2,100,3,7,1,9,11,12,13,14)")
	require.NoError(t, err)
	cubeHandler, err := NewMetricsCube()
	require.NoError(t, err)
	types := typecatalog.NewCatalog()
	resources := resource.New()
	require.NoError(t, resources.Register(DatlyResourceNamespace, &DatlyResources))
	project, err := report.NewProjectCompiler(report.ProjectConfig{Types: types}).CompileArtifacts([]bootstrap.ArtifactInput{
		{Component: reader, InputType: reflect.TypeFor[MetricsInput](), OutputType: reflect.TypeFor[MetricsOutput](), Types: types, Resources: resources},
		{Component: cube, InputType: reflect.TypeFor[MetricsCubeInput](), OutputType: reflect.TypeFor[MetricsCubeOutput](), Handler: cubeHandler, HandlerOwnedOutput: true, Types: types},
	})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	registered, err := project.RuntimeComponents(ctx, report.RuntimeConfigureFunc(func(_ context.Context, artifact *report.ComponentArtifact) (report.RuntimeCapabilities, error) {
		if artifact.ReaderCompilation() == nil {
			return report.RuntimeCapabilities{}, nil
		}
		reader, err := artifact.ReaderCompilation().NewExecution(bootstrap.ReaderRuntimeConfig{SQL: &dsql.SQLComponent{DB: db}})
		return report.RuntimeCapabilities{Reader: reader}, err
	}))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	runtime, err := druntime.NewRuntime(registered)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	defer runtime.Shutdown(ctx)
	request := httptest.NewRequest("POST", "/metrics/cube", strings.NewReader(body))
	request.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	response := httptest.NewRecorder()
	httpgateway.NewHandler(runtime, nil, "").ServeHTTP(response, request)
	require.Equal(t, 200, response.Code, response.Body.String())
	const expected = `[{"reader_v_start":2,"reader_v100":100,"reader_view_conversions":3,"reader_account_id":7,"reader_is_pg":1,"reader_url":9,"reader_v25_threshold":11,"reader_v100_window":12,"reader_control_v_exposed":13}]`
	assertRows := func(wire string) {
		var envelope map[string]json.RawMessage
		require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal([]byte(wire), &envelope))
		rows := envelope["Data"]
		if rows == nil {
			rows = envelope["data"]
		}
		require.JSONEq(t, expected, string(rows))
	}
	assertRows(response.Body.String())
	service, err := mcp.New(mcp.Config{Components: registered, Invoker: runtime})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	tool, ok := service.Catalog().Tool("MetricsCube")
	require.True(t, ok)
	require.NotContains(t, tool.Metadata().InputSchema.Properties["measures"]["properties"], "vsTart")
	require.NotContains(t, tool.Metadata().InputSchema.Properties["filters"]["properties"], "vsTart")
	require.Contains(t, tool.Metadata().InputSchema.Properties["filters"]["properties"], "accountIds")
	for _, invalid := range []string{"v25tHreshold", "v100wIndow", "controlVeXposed", "accountIdS"} {
		for _, section := range []string{"dimensions", "measures", "filters"} {
			require.NotContains(t, tool.Metadata().InputSchema.Properties[section]["properties"], invalid)
		}
	}
	for i, wire := range wires {
		section := "dimensions"
		if i == 0 || i == 2 || i == 7 {
			section = "measures"
		}
		require.Contains(t, tool.Metadata().InputSchema.Properties[section]["properties"], wire)
		require.Contains(t, tool.Metadata().InputSchema.Properties["filters"]["properties"], wire)
	}
	var arguments map[string]any
	require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal([]byte(body), &arguments))
	executable, ok := service.Registry().ToolRegistry.Get("MetricsCube")
	require.True(t, ok)
	result, protocolErr := executable.Handler(ctx, &schema.CallToolRequest{Method: schema.MethodToolsCall, Params: schema.CallToolRequestParams{Name: "MetricsCube", Arguments: arguments}})
	require.Nil(t, protocolErr)
	require.NotNil(t, result)
	require.False(t, result.IsError != nil && *result.IsError)
	assertRows(result.Content[0].(schema.TextContent).Text)
	arguments["dimensions"] = map[string]any{}
	arguments["measures"] = map[string]any{"vStart": true}
	result, protocolErr = executable.Handler(ctx, &schema.CallToolRequest{Method: schema.MethodToolsCall, Params: schema.CallToolRequestParams{Name: "MetricsCube", Arguments: arguments}})
	require.Nil(t, protocolErr)
	require.NotNil(t, result)
	require.False(t, result.IsError != nil && *result.IsError)
	var selected map[string]json.RawMessage
	require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal([]byte(result.Content[0].(schema.TextContent).Text), &selected))
	rows := selected["Data"]
	if rows == nil {
		rows = selected["data"]
	}
	require.JSONEq(t, `[{"reader_v_start":2}]`, string(rows))
}
